They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment</li> <li>Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories</li> <li>Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance</li> <li>Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness</li> <li>Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications to succeed in this project:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Professional fluency in English</li> <li>Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content</li> <li>Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture</li> <li>Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities</li> <li>Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)</li> <li>Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content</li> <li>Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> professional commitments without rigid scheduling</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive research support:</strong> Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains</li> <li><strong>Quality recognition:</strong> Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment</li> <li><strong>Intellectually demanding by design:</strong> If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly
